title: Positive-power nilpotence of a Noetherian scheme nilradical
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. For its nilradical ideal sheaf $N$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction], there exists $n\geq0$ with $N^{n+1}=0$. This includes the empty scheme.

source.place: Proof, Step 1 and the following Claim; proof text retained in the parent DAG node

proof.text: At every point choose an affine open neighbourhood. Its ring of sections is Noetherian by IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian. Apply the Mathlib theorem IsNoetherianRing.isNilpotent_nilradical to obtain an exponent killing the nilradical on that neighbourhood.

Use quasi-compactness to choose a finite subcover, and put n equal to the Finset.sup of the affine exponents. The exponent n+1 is at least every chosen exponent, so Ideal.pow_le_pow_right shows that N^(n+1) is zero on every member of the finite cover. IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top identifies it with the zero ideal sheaf globally. On an empty cover the maximum is zero and equality still holds.
